title: Opinions & discussions
goal: Join a real discussion: agree and disagree politely, say 'it depends' and 'to be honest', guess what might happen, say what someone should have done — about prices, potholes, politics, cricket, football and hockey.
intro:
Odia friends argue happily about everything — the price of onions, the potholes after the monsoon, the elections, and above all cricket (and, this being Odisha, hockey). To join in you need more than *I think*: you need to say **I don't think so**, **you're right but…**, **it depends**, **he might**, **he must have**, and the classic post-match **he should have…**.

This unit adds three tools: **probability** (ହୋଇପାରେ 'might', ଥିବ 'must be'), the polite ways to **agree and disagree** (… ବୋଲି ମୋତେ ଲାଗୁନି 'I don't think…'), and **should have** (-ବା ଉଚିତ ଥିଲା).

vocab.note: ଏକଦମ୍ ଠିକ୍! "exactly right!"; ଏକଦମ୍ ନୂଆ "brand new".
ମୁଁ ତୁମ ସହିତ ଏକମତ "I agree with you". Lit. "one opinion".
The *reasons* you give. A quarrel is ଝଗଡ଼ା.
ମୁଁ ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ନୁହେଁ "I'm not sure". Compare ନିଶ୍ଚୟ "definitely".

Usually takes respectful forms: ସରକାରଙ୍କର "the government's".
ଭୋଟ୍ ଦେବା "to vote". The formal word for election is ନିର୍ବାଚନ.
Used for the cost of living: ସବୁ ଜିନିଷ ମହଙ୍ଗା ହୋଇଯାଇଛି. Compare ଦାମୀ "expensive, high-end".
ବାଜି "a bet" (also means "firecrackers"); ବାଜି ହାରିବା / ଜିତିବା "to lose / win a bet". ବାଜି ଲଗାଇବା? "wanna bet?"

grammar.title: Maybe, might, must be: talking about probability
grammar.body:
You already have **ବୋଧହୁଏ** 'probably' (unit 14) and **ହୁଏତ** 'maybe' (unit 17). Add these:

**It seems / looks like** — **ମନେହୁଏ** at the start: ମନେହୁଏ ବର୍ଷା ହେବ 'looks like it'll rain'.

**Might / could** — the -ଇ form + **ପାରେ**, the same ପାରିବା you use for 'can': ବର୍ଷା ହୋଇପାରେ 'it might rain'; ଇଣ୍ଡିଆ ହାରିପାରେ 'India could lose'; ସେମାନେ ହାରିପାରନ୍ତି 'they might lose'. On its own, **ହୋଇପାରେ** 'could be'. Negative: **ନ ହୋଇପାରେ** 'might not be'.

**Must be (I'm guessing)** — Odia uses the future of ଥିବା, **ଥିବ**, for a confident guess about *now*:
ସେ ଅଫିସରେ ଥିବ 'he must be at the office'
-ଉ + ଥିବ — is doing: ସେ ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ ଦେଖୁଥିବ 'he must be watching the match'
-ଇ + ଥିବ — has done / is in a state: ସେ ଶୋଇଥିବ 'he must be asleep'; ସେ ଭୁଲିଯାଇଥିବ 'he must have forgotten'
The ending follows the person: ଥିବ (he, she, you-familiar), ଥିବେ (they, respectful), ଥିବି (I). Add **ନିଶ୍ଚୟ** to sound sure, or **ବୋଧହୁଏ** to hedge; negative ନ ଥିବ: ସେ ଦେଖି ନ ଥିବ 'he probably hasn't seen it'.

**A scale of certainty**: ନିଶ୍ଚୟ … ଥିବ (must) → ବୋଧହୁଏ (probably) → ମନେହୁଏ (it seems) → ହୁଏତ / -ଇପାରେ (maybe, might) → ମୋର ସନ୍ଦେହ ଅଛି (I doubt it).

**Trap**: -ଇପାରେ means both *can* and *might*. ସେ ଆସିପାରେ is 'he can come' or 'he might come'; add ହୁଏତ if you mean 'might'.

examples.en: India will probably win this match.
He's not picking up — he must be asleep.
Maybe they won't come after all.

grammar.title: Agreeing, disagreeing and 'I don't think…'
grammar.body:
**I think / I don't think**: the opinion comes first, closed by **ବୋଲି**, then the thinking verb. As in English, you negate the *thinking*, not the opinion:
ସେ ଜିତିବ ବୋଲି ମୋତେ **ଲାଗୁନି** 'I don't think he'll win'
ଏ ଯୋଜନା ଠିକ୍ ବୋଲି ମୁଁ **ଭାବୁନି** 'I don't think this plan is right'
You can also start with ମୋତେ ଲାଗୁନି **ଯେ** … (the ଯେ pattern of unit 14). Saying ସେ ଜିତିବ ନାହିଁ ବୋଲି ମୋତେ ଲାଗୁଛି is also correct, but it is a stronger prediction: 'I reckon he *won't* win'.

**Agreeing**: ତୁମେ ଠିକ୍ କହୁଛ / ଠିକ୍ କହିଲ 'you're right'; ଏକଦମ୍ ଠିକ୍ 'exactly'; ମୁଁ ବି ସେଇଆ ଭାବୁଛି 'I think so too'; ମୁଁ ତୁମ ସହିତ ଏକମତ 'I agree with you'.

**Disagreeing politely**: soften it first — ହଁ, କିନ୍ତୁ… 'yes, but…'; ମୋର ମତ ଟିକେ ଅଲଗା 'I see it a bit differently'; ସେମିତି ନୁହେଁ 'it's not quite like that'; ମୁଁ ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ନୁହେଁ 'I'm not sure'. The blunt ତୁମେ ଭୁଲ କହୁଛ 'you're wrong' is fine between close friends, rude to elders.

**Useful frames**: ସେଇଟା ନିର୍ଭର କରେ 'it depends'; … ଉପରେ ନିର୍ଭର କରେ 'it depends on …'; ସତ କହିବାକୁ ଗଲେ… 'to be honest…'; ବାସ୍ତବରେ… 'actually…'; ମୋର ସନ୍ଦେହ ଅଛି 'I doubt it'.

**Trap**: **ନୁହେଁ** (is not) vs **ନାହିଁ** (there isn't / doesn't): ମୁଁ ଏକମତ ନୁହେଁ 'I'm not in agreement', but ମୋର ସନ୍ଦେହ ନାହିଁ 'I have no doubt'.

grammar.title: Should have…: -ବା ଉଚିତ ଥିଲା
grammar.body:
In unit 9 you learned **should**: possessive + -ବା + ଉଚିତ — ତୁମର ବିଶ୍ରାମ ନେବା ଉଚିତ 'you should rest'. Put ଉଚିତ in the past with **ଥିଲା** and you get **should have**:

ତୁମର ଆଗରୁ କହିବା **ଉଚିତ ଥିଲା** 'you should have said so earlier'
ମୋର ଏତେ ଖାଇବା **ଉଚିତ ନ ଥିଲା** 'I shouldn't have eaten so much'
ସରକାରଙ୍କର ରାସ୍ତା ମରାମତି କରିବା ଉଚିତ ଥିଲା 'the government should have fixed the roads'

The person is in the **possessive** (ମୋର, ତୁମର, ତାର, ତାଙ୍କର, ଆମର, ସରକାରଙ୍କର), and the verb stays in the -ବା form — nothing else changes.

**Two everyday alternatives** (from unit 19's conditional):
• **-ଇଥିଲେ ଭଲ ହୋଇଥାନ୍ତା** 'it would have been better if…': ଆମେ ଆଗରୁ ବାହାରିଥିଲେ ଭଲ ହୋଇଥାନ୍ତା
• the bare conditional as a reproach, very common among friends: ଆଗରୁ **କହିଥାନ୍ତ** ନା! 'you could have told me earlier!'

This is the grammar of every post-match discussion: ତାର ସେଇ ବଲ୍ ଛାଡ଼ିଦେବା ଉଚିତ ଥିଲା 'he should have left that ball'.

**Trap**: don't use the subject form — ~~ତୁମେ କହିବା ଉଚିତ ଥିଲା~~ → **ତୁମର** କହିବା ଉଚିତ ଥିଲା.

examples.en: You should have said so earlier.

dialogue.title: India need sixty
dialogue.setting: Bapi, Lipi and Sam watch the last overs of an India–Australia one-day match on the TV at a tea stall in Cuttack.

lines.speaker: Bapi
lines.en: What's the score? I just got here.

lines.speaker: Sam

lines.en: India need sixty more runs, four wickets down.

culture: Arguing is a social sport in Odisha, and a good-natured **ତର୍କ** over tea is a sign of friendship, not hostility. Among friends you can be blunt (ତୁମେ ଭୁଲ କହୁଛ!), but with elders, teachers and in-laws, disagree softly — **ହଁ, କିନ୍ତୁ…**, **ମୋର ମତ ଟିକେ ଅଲଗା** — or not at all. Safe, endless topics: prices (**ସବୁ ଜିନିଷ ମହଙ୍ଗା**), potholes after the monsoon, traffic in Bhubaneswar, heatwaves, and sport. Cricket is followed everywhere, and Cuttack's **Barabati** stadium hosts international matches; Odisha is also India's hockey heartland — the state sponsors the national teams, Bhubaneswar's **Kalinga Stadium** and Rourkela hosted the 2023 men's World Cup, and many national players come from Sundargarh district. **Odisha FC** play football in the Indian Super League. Politics comes up too, but with people you don't know well it's wiser to listen, nod and say **ସେଇଟା ନିର୍ଭର କରେ**.

tip.title: Agreeing and disagreeing
tip.body:
- Agree: **ତୁମେ ଠିକ୍ କହୁଛ**, **ଏକଦମ୍ ଠିକ୍!**, ମୁଁ ତୁମ ସହିତ **ଏକମତ**.
- Disagree softly: **ହଁ, କିନ୍ତୁ…**, **ମୋର ମତ ଟିକେ ଅଲଗା**. Blunt (friends only): ମୁଁ ଏକମତ **ନୁହେଁ**.
- It depends: **ସେଇଟା ନିର୍ଭର କରେ**; on what: … **ଉପରେ** ନିର୍ଭର କରେ.

sentences.en: You're absolutely right.

sentences.en: I don't agree — the traffic's got much worse than before.

sentences.en: That depends on the weather.

sentences.roman: duiṭa kôtha pura ôlôga.
sentences.en: The two things are completely different.

sentences.native: ତୁମ ମତ କ'ଣ? ତୁମେ ରାଜି?
sentences.roman: tumô môtô kôṇô? tume raji?
sentences.en: What's your take? Do you agree?

tip.title: I don't think…
tip.body:
- Opinion + **ବୋଲି** + negated thinking verb: ସେ ଜିତିବ ବୋଲି ମୋତେ **ଲାଗୁନି** / ମୁଁ **ଭାବୁନି**.
- Or: ମୋତେ ଲାଗୁନି **ଯେ** …
- Doubt: … ବୋଲି ମୋର **ସନ୍ଦେହ** ଅଛି. Honest: **ସତ କହିବାକୁ ଗଲେ** …
tip.pattern: opinion + ବୋଲି + ମୋତେ ଲାଗୁନି / ମୁଁ ଭାବୁନି

sentences.native: ଏ ଥର ଦାମ କମିବ ବୋଲି ମୋତେ ଲାଗୁନି।
sentences.roman: e thôrô damô kômibô boli mote laguni.
sentences.en: I don't think prices will come down this time.

sentences.native: ସେ ସତ କହୁଛି ବୋଲି ମୁଁ ଭାବୁନି।
sentences.roman: se sôtô kôhuchhi boli muṃ bhabuni.
sentences.en: I don't think he's telling the truth.

sentences.native: ସତ କହିବାକୁ ଗଲେ, ସିନେମାଟା ଭଲ ବୋଲି ମୁଁ ଭାବୁନି।
sentences.roman: sôtô kôhibaku gôle, sinemaṭa bhôlô boli muṃ bhabuni.
sentences.en: To be honest, I don't think the film is any good.

sentences.native: ତୁମ ଯୁକ୍ତି ଠିକ୍, କିନ୍ତୁ ମୁଁ ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ନୁହେଁ।
sentences.roman: tumô jukti ṭhik, kintu muṃ nischitô nuheṃ.
sentences.en: Your argument makes sense, but I'm not sure.

sentences.native: ବାସ୍ତବରେ ଟ୍ରାଫିକ୍ ବଡ଼ ସମସ୍ୟା ବୋଲି ମୁଁ ଭାବୁନି।
sentences.roman: bastôbôre ṭraphik bôṛô sômôssya boli muṃ bhabuni.
sentences.en: Actually, I don't think traffic is the big problem.

sentences.native: ସେ ସମୟରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିବ ବୋଲି ମୋର ସନ୍ଦେହ ଅଛି।
sentences.roman: se sômôyôre pôhôñchibô boli morô sôndehô ôchhi.
sentences.en: I doubt he'll get there on time.

sentences.native: ମୋତେ ଲାଗୁନି ଯେ ଏ ଯୋଜନା କାମ କରିବ।
sentences.roman: mote laguni je e jojôna kamô kôribô.
sentences.en: I don't think this plan will work.

sentences.native: ତୁମେ ନିଶ୍ଚିତ? ମୋତେ ତ ସନ୍ଦେହ ଲାଗୁଛି।
sentences.roman: tume nischitô? mote tô sôndehô laguchhi.
sentences.en: Are you sure? I have my doubts.

tip.title: Might and must be
tip.body:
- Might: -ଇ + **ପାରେ**: ବର୍ଷା **ହୋଇପାରେ**, ସେ **ଜିତିପାରେ**.
- Must be (a guess): **ଥିବ** — ସେ ଅଫିସରେ **ଥିବ**; with -ଇ for 'must have': ଭୁଲିଯାଇ**ଥିବ**.
- Hedge with **ବୋଧହୁଏ**, **ମନେହୁଏ**, **ହୁଏତ**; be sure with **ନିଶ୍ଚୟ**.

sentences.native: ଆଜି ରାତିରେ ବର୍ଷା ହୋଇପାରେ, ସାବଧାନରେ ଯାଅ।
sentences.roman: aji ratire bôrsa hoipare, sabôdhanôre jaô.
sentences.en: It might rain tonight — go carefully.

sentences.native: ମନେହୁଏ ସେ ଆଜି ଆସିବ ନାହିଁ।
sentences.roman: mônehue se aji asibô nahiṃ.
sentences.en: Looks like he won't come today.

sentences.native: ସେ ଫୋନ ଉଠାଉନି, ବୋଧହୁଏ ଅଫିସରେ ବ୍ୟସ୍ତ ଥିବ।
sentences.roman: se phonô uṭhauni, bodhôhue ôphisre byôstô thibô.
sentences.en: She's not picking up — she's probably busy at work.

sentences.native: ସେମାନେ ନିଶ୍ଚୟ ଟ୍ରାଫିକରେ ଫସିଥିବେ।
sentences.roman: semane nischôyô ṭraphikre phôsithibe.
sentences.en: They must be stuck in traffic.

sentences.native: ଏ ଥର କିଏ ଜିତିପାରେ, ତୁମେ କ'ଣ ଭାବୁଛ?
sentences.roman: e thôrô kie jitipare, tume kôṇô bhabuchhô?
sentences.en: Who might win this time, what do you think?

sentences.native: ମୁଁ ରାଜନୀତି ବିଷୟରେ ବେଶି କଥା ହୁଏନି।
sentences.roman: muṃ rajôniti bisôyôre besi kôtha hueni.
sentences.en: I don't talk about politics much.

sentences.native: ସରକାର ବଦଳିଲେ ହୁଏତ କିଛି ବଦଳିପାରେ।
sentences.roman: sôrôkarô bôdôḷile huetô kichhi bôdôḷipare.
sentences.en: If the government changes, maybe something might change.

sentences.native: ତୁମେ ଭୋଟ୍ ଦେବାକୁ ଯିବ ତ?
sentences.roman: tume bhoṭ debaku jibô tô?
sentences.en: You're going to vote, aren't you?

sentences.native: ସେ ବୋଧହୁଏ ମୋ ମେସେଜ୍ ଦେଖି ନ ଥିବ।
sentences.roman: se bodhôhue mo mesej dekhi nô thibô.
sentences.en: He probably hasn't seen my message.

lessons.title: What should have happened

tip.title: Should have: -ବା ଉଚିତ ଥିଲା
tip.body:
- Possessive + -ବା + **ଉଚିତ ଥିଲା**: **ତୁମର** ଆଗରୁ କହିବା ଉଚିତ ଥିଲା.
- Shouldn't have: **ଉଚିତ ନ ଥିଲା**.
- Not ~~ତୁମେ~~ କହିବା ଉଚିତ — the person is ମୋର, ତୁମର, ତାର, ଆମର, ସରକାରଙ୍କର.
- Softer: … -ଇଥିଲେ **ଭଲ ହୋଇଥାନ୍ତା** 'it would have been better if…'.

new: ଛାଡ଼, ଏ ବିଷୟରେ ତର୍କ କରି ଲାଭ ନାହିଁ।

sentences.native: ସରକାରଙ୍କର ବର୍ଷା ଆଗରୁ ରାସ୍ତା ମରାମତି କରିବା ଉଚିତ ଥିଲା।
sentences.roman: sôrôkarôṅkôrô bôrsa agôru rasta môramôti kôriba uchitô thila.
sentences.en: The government should have repaired the roads before the rains.

sentences.native: ରାସ୍ତାରେ ଏତେ ଖାଲ, ଗାଡ଼ି ଚଳାଇବା କଷ୍ଟ।
sentences.roman: rastare ete khalô, gaṛi chôḷaiba kôsṭô.
sentences.en: So many potholes on the road — it's hard to drive.

sentences.native: ସବୁ ଜିନିଷ ମହଙ୍ଗା ହୋଇଯାଇଛି।
sentences.roman: sôbu jinisô môhôṅga hoijaichhi.
sentences.en: Everything's got so expensive.

sentences.native: ମୋର ସେ ଫୋନ କିଣିବା ଉଚିତ ନ ଥିଲା, ବହୁତ ମହଙ୍ଗା ଥିଲା।
sentences.roman: morô se phonô kiṇiba uchitô nô thila, bôhutô môhôṅga thila.
sentences.en: I shouldn't have bought that phone — it was way too expensive.

sentences.native: ତୁମର ଆଗରୁ ଟିକଟ କିଣିବା ଉଚିତ ଥିଲା।
sentences.roman: tumôrô agôru ṭikôṭô kiṇiba uchitô thila.
sentences.en: You should have bought the tickets in advance.

sentences.native: ଆମର ଆଗରୁ ଗଛ କାଟିବା ବନ୍ଦ କରିବା ଉଚିତ ଥିଲା, ଏବେ ପ୍ରଦୂଷଣ ବଢ଼ୁଛି।
sentences.roman: amôrô agôru gôchhô kaṭiba bôndô kôriba uchitô thila, ebe prôdusôṇô bôṛhuchhi.
sentences.en: We should have stopped cutting down trees long ago — now pollution is rising.

sentences.native: ତୁମେ ଟିକେ ଚିନ୍ତା କରି କହିଥିଲେ ଭଲ ହୋଇଥାନ୍ତା।
sentences.roman: tume ṭike chinta kôri kôhithile bhôlô hoithanta.
sentences.en: It would have been better if you'd thought a bit before speaking.

sentences.native: ଆମର ପ୍ରଦୂଷଣ ବିଷୟରେ ଆଗରୁ ଭାବିବା ଉଚିତ ଥିଲା।
sentences.roman: amôrô prôdusôṇô bisôyôre agôru bhabiba uchitô thila.
sentences.en: We should have thought about pollution earlier.

sentences.native: ସେ ସବୁବେଳେ ତର୍କ କରେ, ସେଥିପାଇଁ ମୁଁ ଚୁପ୍ ରହେ।
sentences.roman: se sôbubeḷe tôrkô kôre, sethipaiṃ muṃ chup rôhe.
sentences.en: He always argues, so I just keep quiet.

tip.title: Predicting the result
tip.body:
- Probably: **ବୋଧହୁଏ** + future: ବୋଧହୁଏ ଇଣ୍ଡିଆ **ଜିତିବ**.
- Might: **-ଇପାରେ** (one) / **-ଇପାରନ୍ତି** (a team as 'they'): ସେମାନେ **ହାରିପାରନ୍ତି**.
- Must be doing: **-ଉଥିବ**: ସେ ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ **ଦେଖୁଥିବ**.

sentences.native: ଆଜିର ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ କିଏ ଜିତିବ?
sentences.roman: ajirô myach kie jitibô?
sentences.en: Who's going to win today's match?

sentences.native: ବୋଧହୁଏ ଇଣ୍ଡିଆ ଜିତିବ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଅଷ୍ଟ୍ରେଲିଆ ବି ଭଲ ଟିମ୍।
sentences.roman: bodhôhue Iṇḍia jitibô, kintu Ôsṭrelia bi bhôlô ṭim.
sentences.en: India will probably win, but Australia's a good team too.

sentences.native: ମୋତେ କ୍ରିକେଟ୍ ଅପେକ୍ଷା ଫୁଟବଲ୍ ବେଶି ଭଲ ଲାଗେ।
sentences.roman: mote krikeṭ ôpekhya phuṭbôl besi bhôlô lage.
sentences.en: I like football more than cricket. (ଅପେକ୍ଷା "than")

sentences.native: ଆମ ଟିମ୍ ଆଜି ଜିତିପାରେ, ଯଦି କ୍ୟାପଟେନ୍ ଭଲ ଖେଳନ୍ତି।
sentences.roman: amô ṭim aji jitipare, jôdi kyapṭen bhôlô kheḷônti.
sentences.en: Our team could win today, if the captain plays well.

sentences.native: ଭାରତୀୟ ଟିମ୍ ଏ ଥର କପ୍ ଜିତିପାରେ।
sentences.roman: Bharôtiyô ṭim e thôrô kôp jitipare.
sentences.en: The Indian team could win the cup this time.

sentences.native: ବର୍ଷା ପାଇଁ ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ ବନ୍ଦ ହୋଇପାରେ।
sentences.roman: bôrsa paiṃ myach bôndô hoipare.
sentences.en: The match might be stopped because of the rain.

sentences.native: ସେ ନିଶ୍ଚୟ ଟିଭିରେ ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ ଦେଖୁଥିବ।
sentences.roman: se nischôyô ṭibhire myach dekhuthibô.
sentences.en: He must be watching the match on TV.

sentences.native: ମୁଁ ଓଡ଼ିଶା ଏଫସିକୁ ସପୋର୍ଟ୍ କରେ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଆଜି ସେମାନେ ହାରିପାରନ୍ତି।
sentences.roman: muṃ Oṛisa Ephsiku sôporṭ kôre, kintu aji semane hariparônti.
sentences.en: I support Odisha FC, but today they might lose.

tip.title: Blame and regrets
tip.body:
- Who should have: **ତାର / କ୍ୟାପଟେନଙ୍କର** + -ବା + **ଉଚିତ ଥିଲା**.
- Shouldn't have: … **ଉଚିତ ନ ଥିଲା**.
- What would have happened: -ଇଥିଲେ … **-ଇଥାନ୍ତା / -ଇଥାନ୍ତୁ**: ସେ ଶଟ୍ ନ ଖେଳିଥିଲେ ଆମେ **ଜିତିଥାନ୍ତୁ**.

sentences.native: କ୍ୟାପଟେନଙ୍କର ଏତେ ଶୀଘ୍ର ଆଉଟ୍ ହେବା ଉଚିତ ନ ଥିଲା।
sentences.roman: kyapṭenôṅkôrô ete sighrô auṭ heba uchitô nô thila.
sentences.en: The captain shouldn't have got out so early.

sentences.native: ସେଇଟା ବହୁତ ଖରାପ ଶଟ୍ ଥିଲା।
sentences.roman: seiṭa bôhutô khôrapô sôṭ thila.
sentences.en: That was a really bad shot.

sentences.native: ଆରେ, ଆଉଟ୍! ତାର ଆଉ ଟିକେ ଧୀରେ ଖେଳିବା ଉଚିତ ଥିଲା।
sentences.roman: are, auṭ! tarô au ṭike dhire kheḷiba uchitô thila.
sentences.en: Oh, out! He should have played a bit more carefully.

sentences.native: ପାଞ୍ଚ ଶହ ଟଙ୍କାର ବାଜି, ଇଣ୍ଡିଆ ଜିତିବ!
sentences.roman: pañchô sôhô ṭôṅkarô baji, Iṇḍia jitibô!
sentences.en: Five hundred rupees says India will win!

sentences.native: ଆମର ଆଜି ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ ଦେଖିବାକୁ କଟକ ଯିବା ଉଚିତ ଥିଲା।
sentences.roman: amôrô aji myach dekhibaku Kôṭôkô jiba uchitô thila.
sentences.en: We should have gone to Cuttack to watch the match today.

sentences.native: କ୍ୟାପଟେନ୍ ଭଲ ଖେଳିଲେ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଅନ୍ୟମାନଙ୍କର ଅଧିକ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରିବା ଉଚିତ ଥିଲା।
sentences.roman: kyapṭen bhôlô kheḷile, kintu ônnyômanôṅkôrô ôdhikô chesṭa kôriba uchitô thila.
sentences.en: The captain played well, but the others should have tried harder.

sentences.native: ତୁମର ମୋ ସହିତ ବାଜି ଲଗାଇବା ଉଚିତ ନ ଥିଲା!
sentences.roman: tumôrô mo sôhitô baji lôgaiba uchitô nô thila!
sentences.en: You shouldn't have bet against me!

sentences.native: ବାଜି ହାରିଲେ ତୁମକୁ ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କୁ ଚା ଖୁଆଇବାକୁ ପଡ଼ିବ।
sentences.roman: baji harile tumôku sômôstôṅku cha khuaibaku pôṛibô.
sentences.en: If you lose the bet, you'll have to buy everyone tea.

sentences.native: ସେ ସେଇ ଶଟ୍ ନ ଖେଳିଥିଲେ ଆମେ ଜିତିଥାନ୍ତୁ।
sentences.roman: se sei sôṭ nô kheḷithile ame jitithantu.
sentences.en: If he hadn't played that shot, we'd have won.
